verdict.rationale: Algolia is clearly API-first. The Search API covers searching, configuring and managing indices and records, and official clients ship in many languages. The CLI and agent skills manage indices, settings, rules and synonyms, and an MCP server exposes search, analytics and recommendations. However, no parity claim is documented, and several capabilities are described only as dashboard actions: connector schedules and transformations configured in the dashboard, analytics CSV/XLSX download, comparison mode, and Merchandising Studio visual tools. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API equivalents for the dashboard-only features (connector config, analytics export, merchandising), a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404), and independent corroboration.
